svg.title: Alex Leschik — Founder, ZEN AI Co.
svg.desc: Alex Leschik, founder of ZEN AI Co. in Washington, D.C. Building Arsenal, an agentic AI platform, and the first youth AI literacy program in U.S. history. On a rotating dotted Earth, flight arcs launch from Washington, D.C., cross the country, then spread around the world, lighting up each region as they arrive.
